decisions.source_text: Dewatering System for Chamber CC6567 Rebuild Operations for Port Lands Flood Protection ($313,750) (Contract awarded by Ellis Don Civil Ltd on behalf of Waterfront Toronto)
decisions.basis: The primary March2023 publication omits a recipient and identifies Ellis Don only as awarding construction manager. The same publisher's March2023 PLFP dashboard names WJ Groundwater for TPBR182 / CM#2023-03, Dewaltering System for Chamber CC6567 Rebuild Operations. That explicit work/package/month relationship corroborates the missing recipient. Keep the primary publication amount; the dashboard estimate, approved amount and contingency drawdown are distinct figures and are not substituted or tax-converted.
